% Takes the place of Fig. 7 of the submitted version as the main figure (R1.10).
% Values = the 'main' set of aggregate.py (plan §4.5 and §12.2, with the intention-to-treat imputation of diverged seeds, if any).
\begin{figure*}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_main_auroc_heatmap.pdf}
  \caption{ROC-AUC of the fused detector (FUS) on the evaluation segment of each stream, for the eleven analysis configurations (mean over the two seeds of the nine stochastic configurations C1--C9; C10 and C11 have no random initialisation and are run once per stream). No cell required the intention-to-treat imputation of a diverged seed. Darker is higher. Cells with ROC-AUC $\leq 0.5$ (chance) are hatched and marked with $*$; cells that do not exceed the row-index baseline of their stream, read as $\max($AUC$_t$, 1 $-$ AUC$_t)$ because a detector returning the decreasing index is equally free, are marked with $\dagger$; the rightmost column shows AUC$_t$ itself, as in the main results table. The threshold-free primary metric and the two trivial references are shown together so that no value is read without its baseline. Configurations: C1--C8 use a temporal context window, C9 (MLP) ignores it, C10 is the KitNET-style control and C11 the statistical layer. No detector or threshold is selected with evaluation labels in this figure.}
  \label{fig:auroc-heatmap}
\end{figure*}
